note: BH-6372.3, BH-8338: perf (default) | all | off. An INCONCLUSIVE claim row in the PR body's evidence table, on a MERGE or MERGE-WITH-NOTES lead verdict, adds ONE finding line that names the claims and the fix. perf: a BLOCK ([BLOCK wrong-data]) only when the ticket the PR closes carries the perf-gate label; else, when pt_classify (bin/lib/perf-ticket.sh) says the ticket or its parent is a perf/cost ticket, MERGE-WITH-NOTES with a [NOTE] line; a class that cannot be read is no cap and one log line. all: a BLOCK on every PR. off: never. Any other value is read as perf and logged.
